name: Newegg marketplace (refurbished server-pull reseller) price page for nvidia-tesla-p40
notes: Refurbished NVIDIA Tesla P40 24GB GDDR5, PCIe 3.0 x16, listed for advanced AI processing. $343.59 asking price, free shipping, 'more options from $343.59-$460.00'. Passive server card - no fan, needs a blower/duct kit (~$40-$46 sold alongside). Other P40 listings on the same search page: $349.60 (refurb, 699-2G610-020), $349.50 (refurb), $397.99-$425.99 (non-refurb/OEM), $413.99 (TCSP40M-24GB-PB), $439.00 (PNY). Multi-variant listing trap noted in prior research does not apply to the P40-specific product pages cited here.
